description: Global Exposure and Risk Database: Global-scale hazard exposure and risk estimates for critical infrastructure is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors S. Nirandjan, Elco Koks (Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam). The Global Exposure and Risk Database accompanies the study by Nirandjan et al. (2026), which presents a global multiple-hazard risk assessments of critical infrastructure. The database contains the exposure and risk estimates underlying the analyses presented in the manuscript. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
